message.content: I’m not sure exactly when the nodules were first discovered, as I’m just here because of the findings from my recent check-up. I haven't had any fevers, night sweats, or a cough. I haven't really noticed any fatigue, weight loss, or dizziness, and I don't recall any recent illnesses or stressors that would have triggered this. I’ve just noticed the mild darkening of my skin over my finger joints and knees.
